title: Discovery index (contracts v0.13, T76): candidates from the survey (T75) for the viewer

synthetic.description: true = not survey output (the hand-made sample, fixtures/discoveries-sample.json); the viewer says so

survey.description: Which run made it, e.g. 'pilot pass 2, 2026-11-20'

name.description: Display name; absent = the viewer shows the position

class.description: T73 candidate classes: cold brown dwarf candidate, infrared variable / transient, spectral outlier, mover

reason.description: Plain words: why it was picked (what moved / changed / is odd)

known.description: Catalogue name if it is a known object (validation / recovery), null or absent = no match

lam_um.description: Wavelength where it shows best (the viewer opens the map band there)

mjd.description: Time the position refers to, if it moves

evidence.description: Free-form numbers behind the score (rates, excesses, epochs, ...)
